scenario: An orthopedics relay lane should close only after the referral ticket, insurer message, previous referral note, requirement note, and final case note still point to the same fresh referral lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the orthopedics relay for case MED-1640. Start from referral ticket RFC-1640, rebuild the supporting trail it cites, and only take the approved close step if the relay still lines up.

medical_referral_case_tickets.body_text: Referral ticket RFC-1640: rebuild the orthopedics relay by checking insurer message IM-1640, previous referral note PRN-1640, requirement note RQN-1640, and case note CN-1640. If no active orthopedics referral remains and the relay still aligns, the approved close step is to submit a fresh orthopedics referral.

medical_insurer_messages.body_text: Insurer message IM-1640: the prior orthopedics intake lane closed after the outside review expired. Once the relay is rebuilt and no active orthopedics referral remains, reopen through a fresh orthopedics referral.

medical_previous_referral_notes.body_text: Previous referral note PRN-1640: the earlier orthopedics route expired after intake drift and should reopen only through a fresh referral.

medical_referral_requirement_notes.body_text: Requirement note RQN-1640: if MED-1640 has no active orthopedics referral left, the approved close step is to submit a new orthopedics referral.

medical_case_notes.body_text: Case note CN-1640: the relay still closes through the fresh orthopedics referral lane once every supporting carrier lines up.
